blurb: Guests rent a private sailboat with a USCG-licensed captain for 2-4 hours. The boat accommodates up to 6 guests and offers flexible routes past NYC landmarks like the Statue of Liberty and Brooklyn Bridge. Options include sunset sails, proposals, birthdays, and corporate events with catering and champagne packages available.
